Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the search results from the WebSurfer. The search results clearly showed a link to "Snackworks" (https://www.snackworks.com) and explicitly stated "Handi-Snacks - Snackworks" and "At Mondelez International, we're on a mission...". The Planner incorrectly dismissed the "Snackworks" result as a "legacy/recipe portal" and ignored the direct association between Handi-Snacks and Snackworks/Mondelez found in the search snippets. Instead, the Planner hallucinated that Handi-Snacks belongs to "The Kraft Heinz Company" (headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, not Illinois, though it has an Illinois presence, the primary HQ is PA) and concluded the task prematurely with the wrong answer. The correct company is Mondelez International (formerly Kraft Foods), which is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The Planner failed to verify the specific headquarters location of the company it identified (Kraft Heinz is not primarily based in Illinois, whereas Mondelez is) and misidentified the brand owner based on a misinterpretation of the search data.
